name: Durchfahrt
title: Overview
text: An interactive design study by Andre Parrocho: Durchfahrt, an all-electric bullet train that runs non-stop across the Philippine archipelago, from Luzon down the Visayas to Mindanao. Cars slip off at speed and pods latch on while it moves, and when a typhoon shuts down air and sea travel its stripes turn orange and it becomes the country's lifeline. Seventh of the Design Studies.

name: Sternweh
title: Overview
text: An interactive 3D design study by Andre Parrocho: Sternweh, a home under the stars and a pilgrimage, one great glass dome sunk into the Atacama Desert in Chile so that only its glass shows above the ground. You arrive only at night, on foot, guided by low lights. Sixth of the Design Studies.

name: Sternweh
title: The dome
text: One dome sunk into the desert, so only its glass shows above the ground. The glass is laminated and walkable, in a fine steel grid that can move in an earthquake.

name: Sternweh
title: The three hearts
text: The sky court, the sleeping chamber and the star room, all under the glass.

name: Sternweh
title: Rooms under the glass
text: Warm wood and textiles. There are no lamps here: at night the stars light these rooms, with tiny amber markers on the steps. By day a woven textile is drawn under the glass to hold the sun’s heat up against it.

name: Sternweh
title: Hallways and kitchen
text: The only rooms with solid ceilings: classical panelled hallways in a ring round the dome, and the kitchen below them beside the white studio. Lit by lamps and floor uplights only, with one spotlight over the kitchen island.

name: Sternweh
title: Arrival
text: Heimweg stops out in the desert and you walk the last stretch at night, guided by low amber lights. Then it drives itself down a hidden ramp into its showroom.

name: Sternweh
title: Off the grid
text: Solar panels far out in the desert, fog catchers on the hills toward the sea, an underground cistern, and the RV beside Heimweg as a water reserve.
